description: SBM owned and leased to client; parent-company guarantees prior to 2010; charter rate continued to end of initial lease period.

SBM impaired Deep Panuke MOPU after decommissioning reassessment
Aker Solutions won Rosebank FPSO upgrade and life-extension EPC

capex.basis: NSTA 2023 report: November 2022 re-baseline of GBP 37bn in 2021 prices, sourced from 2021 UKCS Stewardship Survey, for 2023 onward; full portfolio best estimate, not mobile-only.
NSTA 2023 report: total estimated cost GBP 40bn in 2022 prices for 2023 onward, GBP 3bn above the 2022 re-baseline; full portfolio, not mobile-only.

capex.metric: UKCS decommissioning cost estimate, 2023 onward, 2021 constant prices
capex.basis: NSTA 2024 update: forecast cost of decommissioning from start of 2023 onwards is GBP 40bn in 2021 prices; full portfolio best estimate including adjustments, not mobile-only. Same nominal figure as the 2023 report's GBP 40bn but on a different price basis; kept side by side.

capex.metric: UKCS decommissioning cost estimate, 2024 onward, 2023 prices
capex.basis: NSTA 2024 Appendix 1: 2024 estimate GBP 43bn in 2023 prices; 2022 baseline GBP 37bn in 2021 prices; 2023 estimate GBP 40bn in 2022 prices.
NSTA 2024: decade spend forecast GBP 24bn in 2023 prices, up GBP 3bn from GBP 21bn in 2022 prices; peak GBP 2.5bn per annum.
NSTA 2024 Appendix 5 performance metric 3, GBP 3.7bn for 2024+ in 2023 prices versus GBP 3.4bn for 2023+ in 2022 prices.

capex.metric: Deep Panuke MOPU depreciation at end of lease
capex.basis: SBM 2020 annual report: full depreciation of net book value at end of lease in July 2020, including USD 78m that would have been recognised in 2021 under the initial schedule.

capex.metric: Deep Panuke MOPU impairment from decommissioning cost reassessment
capex.basis: SBM 2020 annual report: adverse cash flows from reassessed demobilisation, towing and green recycling costs; +/- USD 1m per +/-1% discount rate and per +/-USD 1m towing/recycling cost.
SBM 2020 annual report: post-tax discount rate raised to 11.6% from 6.1% in 2019, more conservative production profile ending 2025; +/-USD 1m per +/-1% discount rate.

capex.metric: Rosebank Petrojarl Knarr upgrade EPC, Aker Solutions order intake
capex.basis: Aker press release: expects to book around NOK 2.5bn, reflecting Aker's part of the JV scope; footnote defines substantial contract as NOK 2.5-4.0bn; Norwegian kroner preserved as printed.
